verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show Twilio Video generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data. Video Insights is described only as a performance and data-analysis tool, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions. AI noise cancellation and real-time transcription are adjacent media features, not insights from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
